Divided Voice.name: Divided Voice
Divided Voice.description: The user stretches a continuous ribbon of their smoky body through an open duct between two rooms. For three turns the user keeps one ear solid beside a rescuer and their mouth solid beside a trapped person. The user repeats instructions aloud, then exchanges the positions of mouth and ear to carry the person's reply. The solid parts remain exposed to a hit, and a fan that parts the ribbon cuts the conversation short. Strain: severe.
